job_time.note: hard cap: timeout-minutes 45 on the job; the campaign driver step is bounded with coreutils timeout 2700 s; per-attempt watchdog 3500 ms

resources.concurrency: max-parallel: 1; cells serialized; one job per campaign
resources.disk: results/ only (journals and transcripts); bounded upload of results/
resources.network: ephemeral IPv4 loopback only; no external endpoints

runner.label: ubuntu-latest
runner.note: GitHub-hosted standard runner: 'each GitHub-hosted runner is a new virtual machine (VM) hosted by GitHub' (docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/runners/github-hosted-runners); ubuntu-latest maps to the Ubuntu2404 VM image (github.com/actions/runner-images).

campaign.note: preparation driver; owner-authorized native-Linux campaign not executed

bounds.cpu_time_per_attempt: bounded by the attempt watchdog (3500 ms) and loopback workloads
bounds.network: ephemeral IPv4 loopback TLS listener; peer parks its receive direction; no relay, no delayed encrypted-write await, no privileged network change, no external endpoint

min_matrix.interruption: absolute total deadline (terminal-write pending bound 310 ms; total elapsed bound 500 ms)
min_matrix.stimulus: pipelined terminal write to a parked zero-window peer; deep queue profiles 1-4 (preceding 36864/45056/49152/262144 bytes; requested peer receive 2048/1024/512/1024 bytes; requested target send 2048/1024/512/2048 bytes)

min_matrix.interruption: peer listener cancellation after a bounded interval
phase deadline (<= 120 ms close_notify sub-budget; total elapsed bound 500 ms)
min_matrix.stimulus: peer parks its receive direction after the handshake; close_notify write to the zero-window peer

min_matrix.interruption: peer listener cancellation after a bounded interval
min_matrix.stimulus: zero-window peer plus a gated TLS proxy between sender and peer (the proxy journals the close_notify observation and gates forwarding)

min_matrix.interruption: none required; the drain terminates at the encrypted-byte cap
min_matrix.stimulus: peer flood (tiny 1 byte; large 4096 bytes); declared encrypted cap 32768 bytes; preceding fixture 4096 bytes

min_matrix.interruption: none required; the drain terminates at the plaintext-byte cap; observed WireBytes <= 32768
min_matrix.stimulus: peer flood up to 131072 bytes; declared plaintext cap 8192 bytes
cooperative peer application reads the terminal message and records a receipt; the runner validates digest + byte count
